items.title: Table report
items.description: Sortable, paged table over any source the viewer may query.

items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Bar chart over a query; click a bar to publish a filter.

items.title: Line chart
items.description: Time series with brushing; brushing publishes date.selected.

items.title: Area chart
items.description: Stacked or single area over time.

items.title: Heatmap
items.description: Two-dimensional heatmap with threshold hatching.

items.title: Scatter plot
items.description: Scatter of two measures.

items.title: KPI tile
items.description: One figure with delta and sparkline.

items.title: Saved panel
items.description: Embeds an existing kernel Panel node by reference.

items.title: Board
items.description: A whole existing Dashboard (Meridian board) with its trace ribbon.

items.title: Programme KPIs
items.description: Strip of programme figures (points issued and redeemed today, orders today, active members, badges) with 14-day sparklines.

items.title: Inbox
items.description: Folders, thread list, search, bulk star/archive/read; selecting a thread publishes thread.selected or opens the thread view inside the widget.

items.title: Conversation
items.description: One thread with replies, mentions, attachments metadata, read receipts and a reply box.

items.title: Compose
items.description: Recipient picker (people and groups), subject, body with @mentions, attachments metadata, send.

items.title: Unread messages
items.description: Count plus the latest three unread threads.

items.title: Notifications
items.description: Feed with type filters, mark read, mark all read; rows link to their subject.

items.title: Notification preferences
items.description: Per type and channel (in-app, email, digest) matrix, digest schedule, quiet hours.

items.title: Email and digest log
items.description: What the email stub and digests sent, with suppression reasons.

items.title: Send a notice
items.description: Ad-hoc notification to people and groups.

items.title: Directory
items.description: Searchable, filterable member directory as grid or table.

items.title: Profile card
items.description: Identity, avatar, title, region, tier, groups, roles, contact actions (message, award).

items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: A member's activity (own: everything; others: public events).

items.title: Group
items.description: A group's description, managers and members.

items.title: Groups
items.description: All groups with membership markers.

items.title: Security sessions
items.description: Own browser and MCP sessions with revoke.

items.title: Search results
items.description: Grouped global search results with type filters.

items.title: Points balance
items.description: Balance with live animation, tier and progress to next tier, expiring soon.

items.title: Statement
items.description: Statement lines with filters, opening/closing balances, and transaction detail (entries, lots) inside the widget.

items.title: Transfer points
items.description: Recipient, amount within limits, memo, confirm with balance after.

items.title: Award points
items.description: Manager award to one or many members with category and reason; shows promotion multipliers and approval hold.

items.title: Expiry schedule
items.description: Points expiring by date.

items.title: Tiers
items.description: Tier ladder with perks, member counts and the viewer's position.

items.title: Trial balance
items.description: Ledger invariants and system account balances (finance).

items.title: Ledger accounts
items.description: All accounts with balances; open one to see its statement inside the widget; reverse a transaction.

items.title: Catalogue
items.description: Browse, filter, sort, search; add to cart and wishlist in place; product detail opens inside the widget or publishes product.selected.

items.title: Product
items.description: Artwork, price, stock, tier gate, add to cart, wishlist, reviews with histogram, write a review.

items.title: Featured rewards
items.description: A row of featured or category products.

items.title: Cart
items.description: Lines with quantity steppers and issues, live quote with promotions, checkout flow (delivery, confirm, placed) inside the widget.

items.title: Orders
items.description: Own orders, or all orders for store staff, with status filters and transitions; detail inside the widget.

items.title: Order
items.description: One order: lines, promotions, timeline, allowed transitions.

items.title: Wishlist
items.description: Saved products with stock and affordability; move to cart.

items.title: Inventory
items.description: Stock levels, low and out filters, restock and corrections.

items.title: Badge showcase
items.description: Up to three pinned badges plus the earned count; the owner can re-pick the showcase.

items.title: Next badges
items.description: Badges in progress with rings and what is left.

items.title: All badges
items.description: Every badge with earned, in progress and locked filters; badge detail inside the widget; manual award for managers.

items.title: Recent awards
items.description: Organisation-wide award ticker.

items.title: Promotions
items.description: All promotions by status with window, usage bar and pending approvals; create new.

items.title: Promotion builder
items.description: Rule builder: eligibility (ruleBuilder + pickers), effects, budget, schedule, stacking; save draft, transition, history and diff.

items.title: Simulator
items.description: Pick a member and a sample cart or earn event; see applied, rejected with reasons, totals, baseline.

items.title: Promotion performance
items.description: Redemptions, cost, budget, by tier and region, uplift; for one promotion or all active.

items.title: Offers for you
items.description: Member-facing banners for promotions the viewer qualifies for.

items.title: Automations
items.description: Automations with trigger, enabled switch, last run, failures, next fire.

items.title: Automation builder
items.description: Trigger picker (event, schedule, metric with query), conditions (ruleBuilder), step list with per-step forms, limits; dry run, run now, enable.

items.title: Run history
items.description: Runs with status filters; run detail with per-step status, retry and cancel inside the widget.

items.title: News feed
items.description: Published content targeted to the viewer, pinned first, reactions inline; reading view inside the widget.

items.title: Article
items.description: One published item rendered from its blocks with reactions.

items.title: Content editor
items.description: Block editor with side preview, metadata, audience, reviewers, schedule; workflow actions; versions and block diff.

items.title: Review queue
items.description: Items awaiting the viewer's review with diff since last review, approve or request changes.

items.title: Content
items.description: All content by status, type, tag and author; engagement counts.

items.title: Segments
items.description: Segments with live counts and where they are used.

items.title: Segment builder
items.description: Rule builder over member facts with live count, distribution and sample members.

items.title: Segment members
items.description: Members matching a segment now.

items.title: Calendar
items.description: Month grid of promotion windows, content schedules, cron fires, expiry and due dates.

items.title: Agenda
items.description: The next N days as a list.

items.title: Approvals
items.description: Unified approvals (changes, actions, high-value orders, content reviews) with SoD reasons, decide inline with diff/detail.

items.title: Tasks
